items.title: Who pays the agent
items.text: The landlord pays their own agent and the lease's costs; their agent charging you is a red flag. Hiring us is optional, in writing.

items.title: The deposit
items.text: Habitual lease: one month. Other lease types differ, and agents ask for more. We check.

items.title: The rent
items.text: No regional cap in Madrid: the asking price is the market. We say if it is out of line and read the update clause.

items.title: Contract type
items.text: A habitual-residence lease protects you in ways a 'temporada' lease does not. We check which one you are handed, and which charges land on you.

items.title: Registration
items.text: Registered at the town hall with your contract: health card and school place hang on it. We confirm it before you sign.

papers.summary: The papers a Spanish landlord asks for
papers.tail: The rest we go through on the free call.

items.q: Isn't it the landlord who pays the agent in Spain now?
items.a: Yes. Spanish law puts the costs of the landlord's agent and of the lease on the landlord, so that agent charging you is a red flag. BOOM Madrid is a separate, optional service you hire in writing, price shown first; it works only for you and takes nothing from landlords.

items.q: What happens on the free call?
items.a: A call with Valentino, by phone or WhatsApp, at a time that suits you both. We hear your dates, budget and who is moving, say which service fits, or that none does, and which papers you are missing. Nothing is charged for the call. Full Search is refunded in full if we decline the search in the first call.

items.q: How do I avoid a rental scam in Madrid from abroad?
items.a: Never pay a deposit or first rent for a home nobody on your side has seen. With Attended Viewing (€149) a BOOM person visits it in your place, with live video and a written report. With Full Search or Application Pack we also check the contract, and that you can register on the padrón with it, before you sign.

items.q: What if you don't find anything?
items.a: We tell you in the first call if your budget and timeline don't fit the market; if BOOM declines the search then, the €500 Full Search fee is refunded in full. Once we take it on, the search runs until you sign or stop it, and the fee pays for the work, not for a result.
